blocks.arabic_text: لَا يَكُوْنَ دِيْنَارٌ وَلَا دِرْهَمٌ، اِنْ كَانَ لَهُ عَمَلٌ صَالِحٌ اُخِذَ مِنْهُ بِقَدْرِ مَظْلَمَتِهِ، وَاِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ حَسَنَاتٌ اُخِذَ مِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ صَاحِبِهِ فَحُمِلَ عَلَيْهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب من كانت له مظلمة عند الرجل...، رقم:٢٤٤٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “If a Muslim has unjustly taken away the honour and dignity (right) of another Muslim, then today, before the Day comes when gold and silver coins will be of no benefit, ask him for forgiveness for having taken away his right and obtain it. (Because on that Day all accounts and dealings will take place only on the basis of good and bad deeds.) So, if the one who did the injustice has any good deed, the amount of his injustice will be taken from him and given to the one who was wronged. If the one who did the injustice has no good deeds, then from the sins of the one who was wronged, the amount of the injustice will be taken and loaded onto the one who did the injustice.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: وَاَرْبَي الرِّبَا اِسْتِطاَلَةُ الرَّجُلِ فِيْ عِرْضِ اَخِيْهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه الطبراني في الاوسط وهو حديث صحيح، الجامع الصغير:٢٢/٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “The worst form of interest is dishonouring one's Muslim brother” (lowering his dignity, in whatever way it is done! For example, whether it is by backbiting, by regarding him as contemptible, or by humiliating him) Hazrat Bara ibn Azib (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The reason why dishonouring a Muslim has been called the worst interest is that, just as in interest one takes another person's wealth
